picks.name: Tiger Stripes
picks.source_note: New artist discovery on Rekids (already followed).
picks.bio: "A Tiger Never Loses Its Stripes (Part 1)" (October 2, 2026, Rekids) is a four-track EP -- Slow, Twelve, Stay Hypnotic, Shape The Future -- from Sweden's Mikael Nordgren, previewing his upcoming sophomore album, his first in two decades.
picks.why_listen: Hypnotic, well-built house tracks from a veteran producer re-emerging on a trusted label -- solid groove tools for a mid-set stretch.

release.title: A Tiger Never Loses Its Stripes (Part 1)

picks.name: Argento
picks.source_note: New artist discovery (David August's new project) on Music From Memory. Similar Balearic/ambient territory to your Bitchin Bajas and nthng picks.
picks.bio: "Miraggi" (September 10, 2026, Music From Memory) introduces David August's Argento project -- an ambient LP shaped by time between Berlin and the Tuscan coast, blending ambient electronics, Balearic textures and acoustic percussion with drummer Lorenzo Setti, drawing on 1970s-80s Italian library music.
picks.why_listen: Warm, improvisation-rooted Balearic ambient -- good for a sunrise set or a slow, textural stretch.
